At 1Office I helped run three B2B ebook campaigns. Rather than treating social, landing pages and email as separate assets, I try to keep one thread of messaging running through the reader's journey. What I learned is that a funnel's effectiveness lies not in any single touchpoint, but in how each touchpoint gives the reader a reasonable reason to move on.
在 1Office，我参与执行了三个 B2B 电子书活动。我不把社交媒体、落地页和邮件当作彼此独立的素材，而是努力让一条信息主线贯穿读者的整个旅程。我从中学到：漏斗的效果不在于某个单独触点，而在于每个触点是否给了读者继续往下走的合理理由。
Facebook hoặc LinkedIn thường là nơi…: Facebook or LinkedIn is usually where readers first meet the problem. The landing page has to say more clearly who the document is for, how it helps, and why it is worth leaving details for. Nurture emails then keep opening up the problem instead of just repeating the ebook. SEO runs alongside as a long-term content layer that catches search demand that already exists.
Facebook 或 LinkedIn 通常是读者第一次接触问题的地方。落地页需要更清楚地说明这份资料适合谁、能帮到什么、为什么值得留下信息。之后的培育邮件继续深入问题，而不是重复介绍电子书。SEO 则作为长期内容层并行运行，承接已经存在的搜索需求。
Social, landing page, email và SEO cùng: Social, landing pages, email and SEO sit in one journey, but each touchpoint has to do a different job to give the reader a reason to keep engaging.
社交媒体、落地页、邮件和 SEO 处于同一条旅程中，但每个触点需要承担不同的任务，才能让读者有理由继续互动。
Ở social, tôi thường bắt đầu từ tension…: On social, I usually start from a tension or pain point close to the target group's daily work.
在社交媒体上，我通常从目标人群日常工作中接近的矛盾或痛点切入。
Confirmation email và ABM sequence được: The confirmation email and ABM sequence keep the thread going after the first download. Instead of repeating the whole document, I write to continue the problem: its consequences, the approach, and situations the reader may face in practice.
确认邮件和 ABM 邮件序列用于在首次下载之后延续这条主线。我不重复资料的全部内容，而是沿着问题继续写下去：它的后果、应对思路，以及读者在现实中可能遇到的情境。
Song song với các ebook, tôi viết 2-3 bà: Alongside the ebooks, I write 2–3 SEO articles a day on assigned topics and handle on-page work. Campaign content usually starts from the message I want to put out; SEO makes me look harder at intent that already exists: what people are actively searching for and how the content should answer it.
在电子书之外，我每天按分配的主题撰写 2–3 篇 SEO 文章并负责页面优化。活动内容通常从我想传达的信息出发；而 SEO 让我更多地关注已经存在的搜索意图：用户在主动搜索什么，内容该如何回答。
Ở mỗi ebook, tôi không dùng các touchpoi: For each ebook, I don't use the touchpoints as places that repeat the same message. Facebook/LinkedIn attract attention and open the problem; the landing page turns interest into a download; email keeps nurturing the lead after the download; and SEO gives the content a natural search lifespan and brings new readers back into the funnel. Each touchpoint therefore has its own job, yet all lead to one coherent journey.
对每本电子书，我不把各个触点当作重复同一信息的地方。Facebook/LinkedIn 负责吸引注意力并引出问题；落地页把兴趣转化为下载资料的行动；邮件在下载之后继续培育线索；SEO 则让内容拥有自然的搜索生命周期，并把新读者带回漏斗。因此每个触点都有各自的任务，却共同通向一条统一的旅程。

Facebook 广告和 LinkedIn 提出矛盾或痛点，把合适的读者拉进漏斗。

At Vincom Retail, I handled many parts of a campaign end to end, from planning and content development to tracking performance and proposing adjustments for the next activities. I worked directly with many malls, stores and contractors to make sure plans were delivered on schedule and every party understood its part.

Beyond execution, I tracked owned media metrics after each campaign, compiled and reported the results, and used them to identify which content and approaches to continue or change. The clearest lesson from this period was how to run owned media based on real data: track the numbers, then adjust the content for the next cycle.

PG là người tạo đơn và điền biểu mẫu, cò: Promotional staff create orders and fill out the forms, while the mall management team checks and confirms them and hands them to the driver.
